Round a Temporal value

Source: R/temporal.R, R/duration.R, R/instant.R, and 3 more
temporal_round.Rd

Temporal's round(), to an increment of smallest_unit with one of the nine rounding modes (design 6.4). plain_time() rounds within the day; plain_date_time() carries into the date and also accepts "day".

Usage

temporal_round(
  x,
  smallest_unit = NULL,
  rounding_increment = 1,
  rounding_mode = "halfExpand",
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_duration'
temporal_round(
  x,
  smallest_unit = NULL,
  rounding_increment = 1,
  rounding_mode = "halfExpand",
  ...,
  largest_unit = NULL,
  relative_to = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_instant'
temporal_round(
  x,
  smallest_unit = NULL,
  rounding_increment = 1,
  rounding_mode = "halfExpand",
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_plain_date_time'
temporal_round(
  x,
  smallest_unit = NULL,
  rounding_increment = 1,
  rounding_mode = "halfExpand",
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_plain_time'
temporal_round(
  x,
  smallest_unit = NULL,
  rounding_increment = 1,
  rounding_mode = "halfExpand",
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_zoned_date_time'
temporal_round(
  x,
  smallest_unit = NULL,
  rounding_increment = 1,
  rounding_mode = "halfExpand",
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A zutempo value.

smallest_unit

The unit to round to: "hour", "minute", "second", "millisecond", "microsecond" or "nanosecond", or their plurals; "day" for a plain_date_time() or a zoned_date_time(), where a day is that calendar day in the zone, however long; any unit for a duration(), which may instead give only largest_unit.

rounding_increment

A positive integer that divides the next larger unit evenly: 24 hours, 60 minutes or seconds, 1000 of the sub-second units, and 1 for "day".

rounding_mode

One of "ceil", "floor", "expand", "trunc", "halfCeil", "halfFloor", "halfExpand" (the default), "halfTrunc" or "halfEven".

...

Must be empty, except for a duration()'s largest_unit and relative_to.

largest_unit

For a duration(): the unit to balance up to, "auto" or NULL for the duration's own largest unit.

relative_to

For a duration(): a plain_date(), plain_date_time(), zoned_date_time() or a string one of them reads, required to round years, months or weeks; with a zoned value, days follow the zone (design 6.5).

Value

A value of the same class as x.

Examples

temporal_round(plain_time("12:34:56"), "minute")
#> <zutempo_plain_time[1]>
#> [1] 12:35:00
temporal_round(plain_time("12:34:56"), "hour", rounding_mode = "floor")
#> <zutempo_plain_time[1]>
#> [1] 12:00:00
temporal_round(plain_date_time("2026-01-31T23:59"), "hour")
#> <zutempo_plain_date_time[1]>
#> [1] 2026-02-01T00:00:00
temporal_round(duration(hours = 25), largest_unit = "day")
#> <zutempo_duration[1]>
#> [1] P1DT1H
temporal_round(duration(hours = 25), largest_unit = "day", relative_to = "2026-03-07")
#> <zutempo_duration[1]>
#> [1] P1DT1H
